title: ChallengeDesignsResponse
description: The design chosen, the challenger's answers, and where two designs differed.

path.description: light: one designer. full: two designers who wrote apart.

chosen.description: The design chosen: first or second as written, or merged, given in design.

design.description: The chosen design, as schemas/design.json gives it.

id.description: The practice's id, such as P-35.

answer.description: Whether the design holds the practice.

sentence.description: Why, in one sentence; for not-held, where the design breaks it.

practices.description: One answer for each practice held by design, by id.

wrong.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.

where.description: Where in the design: a module, an interface, an action or an example, by name.

fix.description: What would fix it, in one sentence.

findings.description: What is wrong with the design that is not a practice's answer, at most 10, each what is wrong, where and what would fix it.

sentence.description: What the design leaves open, in one plain sentence on one line that a person who has not read the design understands.

touches.description: The condition it touches, by id, such as O1-C4, or the judged requirement, as J and its place in the requirements' judged list, such as J1; left out when it touches neither.

undecided.description: What the design leaves open that a builder would otherwise decide silently: behaviour a person would notice or that touches a signed requirement, never how it is built. At most 8, the most important first; empty when the review finds nothing open.

differences.description: Where the two designs differ, one line each, worked out by script; empty with one design.

stayed.description: A branch forge asked to drop and worktrees kept, with the reason it gave; left out when every drop went through.

reason.description: worktrees.drop-branch's sentence: why the branch was kept and what would let it go.
